title: Administrator
description:
Location: Cumberland Infirmary, Carlisle Salary: Competitive, depending on experience Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:30am-2:00pm (22.5 hours per week) Job Type: Permanent, Part-Time

We are looking for an experienced Consumables Stock Controller to join our client's team at Cumberland Infirmary. This is a great opportunity for someone with a background in stock control, warehousing or inventory management who is organised, accurate and enjoys working in a busy environment.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage stock levels, inventory and ordering of consumables.
- Receive, check, store and rotate stock.
- Carry out regular stock checks and reconciliations.
- Manage stock transfers, recalls, expired products and discrepancies.
- Liaise with suppliers, procurement and finance teams.
- Provide stock support to clinical teams.

Essential
- Minimum 3 years' warehousing/inventory management experience.
- Strong stock control experience.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel.
- Excellent organisation and attention to detail.
- Strong communication and administration skills.

Desirable
- Previous NHS or healthcare experience.
- Warehouse management experience.
- Full UK driving licence, as occasional travel may be required.

Please note: An Enhanced DBS check will be required for the successful applicant.

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
As a payroll admin, your main duties and responsibilities in the role are:
- Payroll Processing: Administer end-to-end monthly payroll and Time & Attendance systems accurately within deadlines.
- Data & Adjustments: Manage all employee records, tracking starters, leavers, overtime, allowances, and deductions.
- Compliance & Audits: Handle PAYE, National Insurance, pensions, P60s, and audits in strict alignment with GDPR.
- Query Resolution: Serve as the main point of contact to resolve pay queries for staff and managers efficiently.
- Financial Control: Reconcile payroll reports, investigate discrepancies, and ensure all changes have formal authorisation.
- Cross-Team Collaboration: Partner with HR, Finance, and operations to streamline processes and drive continuous improvements.

As a payroll admin, you will receive the following company benefits:
- Additional leave
- Company pension
- Cycle to work scheme
- Employee discount
- Health & wellbeing programme
- On-site parking
- Referral programme
- Sick pay

title: Payroll Administrator
description:
Payroll Administrator
- Location: Penrith
- Job Type: Part-Time, Permanent (24 Hours per Week)
- Salary: Competitive DOE

We are delighted to be recruiting on behalf of a fantastic client for a Payroll Administrator position based in Penrith. Joining a well-established and highly reputable business, this role is ideal for experienced administrators seeking a new challenge in a supportive and friendly environment. Previous payroll experience would be beneficial; however, we also welcome applications from highly organised administrators with strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and experience working within compliance-driven environments. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a respected organisation and build a rewarding career within payroll administration.

Day-to-day of the role:
- Support payroll administration processes to ensure smooth and efficient operations.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date records and employee information.
- Ensure compliance with relevant policies and procedures.
- Manage workload effectively to meet deadlines.
- Handle confidential information with discretion and integrity.

Required Skills & Qualifications:
- Previous administration experience is essential.
- Excellent organisational and time management skills.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy.
- Experience working within compliance-driven or process-led environments.
- Ability to keep up to date with legislation, policies, and procedures.
- Strong communication skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities.

Interested? Apply today

title: Administration Assistant
company: Cumbria, Northumberland, Tyne and wear (CNTW) NHS Foundation Trust

description: An exciting opportunity has arisen for an experienced person to work as an Administration Assistant in our North Cumbria Inpatient Services. You will be the first point of contact working on reception in a ward environment, providing administrative support directly to the ward multidisciplinary team and supporting across all wardswhen required. This role provides a comprehensive administrative support to the service, working Monday to Wednesday 9am to 5pm. Proven experience of working in similar work environment is an advantage. The post holder will be able to evidence: Experience of front-facing reception duties. Experience of call handling in a busy environment - It is critical that excellent customer service is delivered in person or over the telephone. Good organisational skills. Be able to prioritise a fluctuating workload. Proven experience of working with Microsoft Office packages. Diary management skills to coordinate room bookings. Provides agreed levels of support to the service to maintain cover in the absence of other administrative staff. Desirable: A working knowledge of electronic patient record systems (i.e. RiO) The post holder must be able to demonstrate the ability to deal with possible exposure to highly distressing or highly emotional circumstances and will be expected to participate in all relevant training courses appropriate to the role. The post holder may also undertake additional duties as directed by the Administration Manager. General administrative duties Accurate typing skills - typing letters/reports Diary management including room allocations Working from shared inbox Experienced in the use of Microsoft packages i.e Outlook and Word Ordering stock Issuing and maintaining security equipment i.e. Key cards, SAS alarms, and using a variety of systems that are part of the security processes at the Clinical Business Unit. Please find attached job description for full details. Advertising date : 20th November 2026 Closing date : 2nd December 2026 We welcome your application.
